references.text: The laws concerning fruit trees and their fruit, which show God's care for trees and their usefulness to people
The sabbatical year for the land, illustrating the principle of preserving nature's resources and not exploiting them completely
The continuation of the law allowing the cutting down of trees that do not bear food, to be used as siege weapons
A prophetic text about trees clapping their hands, showing God's care for creation and the significance of nature
The image of a tree being planted and growing, symbolizing God's care for growth and protection
A description of withering trees, illustrating the consequences when nature is not cared for
The tree of life that bears fruit and brings healing, showing the eternal value of fruitful trees
